entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi, David. I... I hope you can help. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. I haven't even used it. Right after it was delivered, I had a sudden family emergency and had to be at the hospital for weeks. My husband had to have unexpected surgery. It's just been a very overwhelming time.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright now. Let me pull up your account to check the delivery date. One moment.
Thank you. Is it going to be a problem? I feel like so much time has passed. Can't you just help me?
I understand your concern. Let's see... it looks like the VeloBand was delivered 37 days ago. Okay, I'm checking our policies now.
37 days? Oh no, that sounds like a long time.
Actually, you have nothing to worry about. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. You are well within that window.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it after everything that happened with the hospital and the surgery.

Not at all. I've just processed the return authorization for you. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just attach that to the box and you can drop it off at any shipping center. You'll receive a full refund once it arrives back at our warehouse.
Wow. That was so much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, David. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
